_comment: Locators of the GSN GUI (GsnPage). Name -> selector, or an object with selector, description and heal (default true; false for elements that may legitimately be absent). Keys starting with _ are ignored. The login selectors are Keycloak's defaults: check them against the real page.

loginInput.description: user name input of the login form

passwordInput.description: password input of the login form

loginButton.description: sign in button of the login form
